ayahs.2: Qasam hai is wazahat wali kitaab ki.
ayahs.3: Yaqeenan hum ne ise ba-barkat raat mein utaara hai, beshak hum daraane wale hain.
ayahs.4: Isi raat mein har ek mazboot kaam ka faisla kiya jaata hai.
ayahs.5: Hamare paas se hukm ho kar, hum hi hain Rasool bana kar bhejne wale.
ayahs.6: Aap ke Rabb ki mehrbaani se. Wohi hai sunne wala, jaanne wala.
ayahs.7: Jo Rabb hai aasmanon ka aur zameen ka aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyaan hai. Agar tum yaqeen karne wale ho.
ayahs.8: Koi mabood nahin us ke siwa, wohi jilaata hai aur maarta hai, wohi tumhara Rabb hai aur tumhare agle baap-dadaon ka.
ayahs.9: Balke woh shak mein pade khel rahe hain.
ayahs.10: Aap us din ke muntazir rahen jabke aasman zaahir dhuaan laayega.
ayahs.11: Jo logon ko gher lega, yeh dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.12: Kahenge ke ae hamare Rabb! Yeh aafat hum se door kar, hum imaan qabool karte hain.
ayahs.13: Un ke liye naseehat kahan hai? Khol khol kar bayan karne wale Paighambar un ke paas aa chuke.
ayahs.14: Phir bhi unhon ne un se munh phera aur keh diya ke sikhaya padhaya hua baaolaa hai.
ayahs.15: Hum azaab ko thoda door kar denge to tum phir apni isi haalat par aa jaaoge.
ayahs.16: Jis din hum badi sakht pakad pakdenge, bilyaqeen hum badla lene wale hain.
ayahs.17: Yaqeenan un se pehle hum qaum-e-Firaun ko (bhi) aazma chuke hain, jin ke paas (Allah) ka ba-izzat Rasool aaya.
ayahs.18: Ke Allah Taala ke bandon ko mere hawale kar do, yaqeen maano ke main tumhare liye amaanat-daar Rasool hoon.
ayahs.19: Aur tum Allah Taala ke saamne sarkashi na karo, main tumhare paas khuli daleel laane wala hoon.
ayahs.20: Aur main apne aur tumhare Rabb ki panaah mein aata hoon is se ke tum mujhe sangsaar kar do.
ayahs.21: Aur agar tum mujh par imaan nahin laate to mujh se alag hi raho.
ayahs.22: Phir unhon ne apne Rabb se dua ki ke yeh sab gunaahgaar log hain.
ayahs.23: (Hum ne keh diya) ke raaton raat to mere bandon ko le kar nikal, yaqeenan tumhara peechha kiya jaayega.
ayahs.24: To darya ko saakin chhod kar chala ja, bila-shubha yeh lashkar gharq kar diya jaayega.
ayahs.25: Woh bahut se baaghaat aur chashme chhod gaye.
ayahs.27: Aur woh aaraam ki cheezen jin mein aish kar rahe the.
ayahs.28: Isi tarah ho gaya aur hum ne un sab ka waaris doosri qaum ko bana diya.
ayahs.29: So un par na to aasman-o-zameen roye aur na unhein mohlat mili.
ayahs.30: Aur beshak hum ne (hi) Bani Israil ko (sakht) ruswa-kun saza se najat di.
ayahs.31: (Jo) Firaun ki taraf se (ho rahi) thi. Fil-waaqea woh sarkash aur hadd se guzar jaane walon mein se tha.
ayahs.32: Aur hum ne daanista taur par Bani Israil ko dunya jahaan walon par fauqiyat di.
ayahs.33: Aur hum ne unhein aisi nishaniyan deen jin mein sareeh aazmaish thi.
ayahs.34: Yeh log to yehi kehte hain.
ayahs.35: Ke (aakhiri cheez) yehi hamari pehli baar (dunya se) mar jaana hai aur hum dobara uthaaye nahin jaayenge.
ayahs.36: Agar tum sachche ho to hamare baap-dadaon ko le aao.
ayahs.37: Kya yeh log behtar hain ya Tubba ki qaum ke log aur jo un se bhi pehle the. Hum ne un sab ko halaak kar diya, yaqeenan woh gunaahgaar the.
ayahs.38: Hum ne zameen aur aasmanon aur un ke darmiyaan ki cheezon ko khel ke taur par paida nahin kiya.
ayahs.39: Balke hum ne unhein durust tadbeer ke saath hi paida kiya hai, lekin un mein se aksar log nahin jaante.
ayahs.40: Yaqeenan faisle ka din un sab ka tay-shuda waqt hai.
ayahs.41: Us din koi dost kisi dost ke kuchh bhi kaam na aayega aur na un ki imdaad ki jaayegi.
ayahs.42: Magar jis par Allah ki mehrbaani ho jaaye, woh zabardast aur reham karne wala hai.
ayahs.45: Jo misl-e-talchhat ke hai aur pait mein khaulta rehta hai.
ayahs.47: Ise pakad lo, phir ghaseette hue beech jahannam tak pahunchaao.
ayahs.48: Phir is ke sar par sakht garam paani ka azaab bahaao.
ayahs.49: (Is se kaha jaayega) chakhta ja, tu to bada zi-izzat aur bade ikraam wala tha.
ayahs.50: Yehi woh cheez hai jis mein tum shak kiya karte the.
ayahs.51: Beshak (Allah se) darne wale aman-chain ki jagah mein honge.
ayahs.53: Bareek aur dabeez resham ke libaas pehne hue aamne saamne baithe honge.
ayahs.54: Yeh isi tarah hai aur hum badi badi aankhon wali hooron se un ka nikah kar denge.
ayahs.55: dil-jamee ke saath wahan har tarah ke mewon ki farmaishen karte honge.
ayahs.56: Wahan woh maut chakhne ke nahin, haan pehli maut (jo woh mar chuke), unhein Allah Taala ne dozakh ki saza se bacha diya.
ayahs.57: Yeh sirf tere Rabb ka fazl hai, yehi hai badi kamyabi.
ayahs.58: Hum ne is (Quran) ko teri zubaan mein aasaan kar diya taake woh naseehat haasil karen.
ayahs.59: Ab tu muntazir reh, yeh bhi muntazir hain.
